subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice cutoff cadence and early-pay pathway
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearvault.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@clearvault.io
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearVault — onboarding docs + question on invoice cadence

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks again for choosing ClearVault for secure key storage — excited to get set up. Attached are our standard onboarding packet and W-9. A couple quick items we want to confirm before we submit our vendor profile to your AP portal: 

- Preferred invoice frequency: monthly (one invoice per month)
- Current payment terms we typically request: Net 30, with an early-pay option at 1.5% for payment within 10 days (we call this EWA).
- PO handling: we can accept either PO number on invoice or a blanket PO with monthly invoice referencing the PO.

Can you confirm Redwood’s preferred invoice cutoff date (e.g., 1st of month vs last-of-month) and whether an early-pay discount program is available / what the process looks like? We can tailor our invoice dates and format to match.

Attachments: ClearVault_Onboarding_Form.pdf, W-9_ClearVault.pdf

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Commercial Operations — ClearVault, Inc.
S: 415-555-0182
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearvault.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearVault — onboarding docs + question on invoice cadence

Hi Samantha — welcome, and thanks for sending these over. Quick answers while we intake the paperwork: 

- Invoice cutoff: Our AP team prefers month-end invoices with a cutoff on the last business day of the month. Invoices dated and submitted by that day post against the current month’s cycle.
- Payment terms: Standard Redwood terms are Net 45 for most new vendors by default while vendor verification/PO integration completes. We do have an early-pay program (AP EarlyPay) that operations runs — typically we evaluate requests for a vendor-level early-pay rate (0.5–2.0%) depending on volume and contract.
- PO process: We can issue a blanket PO for recurring monthly services; invoices then reference the blanket PO number.

Action items: 
1) Marissa / Priyom — can you run ClearVault’s onboarding packet through vendor verification and confirm whether we can make them Net 30 immediately or default to Net 45 pending vendor checks?
2) Priyom — please flag if you need a credit check or additional docs; Samantha, we’ll follow up privately if needed.

Samantha — if you can share a short note on expected monthly spend band, that helps accelerate the early-pay evaluation.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearvault.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearVault — onboarding docs + question on invoice cadence

Hi all,

Thanks Samantha — I pulled the packet and W-9. Quick notes from vendor verification: 
- Company name matches tax docs; good to go on W-9.
- Need a copy of the onboarding contact’s government ID (we redact after verification) — Samantha, can you upload to the DocuSign link Vivek shared or reply here?
- For payment terms: our default onboarding path sets vendors to Net 45 until the blanket PO is established and we've completed a 30-day sample invoice match. Once PoA and PO are in place, we can switch to Net 30.

Regarding early-pay: we run EWA requests through Finance (Naomi). Finance typically approves when monthly billed spend exceeds $15k and vendor agrees to automated remittance via ACH or our AP portal. The typical approved discount range is 0.75%–1.75% depending on volume and tenure.

Priyom — capturing you to start the PO configuration and to set the invoice cutoff to last business day.

Marissa Cole
Vendor Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearvault.io>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearVault — onboarding docs + question on invoice cadence

Hi Samantha — quick follow from procurement/PO lane. A couple process items: 

1) PO approach: we will generate a blanket PO (PO-RED-2026-734) that you can reference on each monthly invoice. I’ve created the PO in the portal and will send the official PDF once acceptance is confirmed.
2) Invoice cutoff: set to last business day as discussed — for August that is 31 Aug 2026; invoice received by EOD 31 Aug will count against August.
3) Early-pay proposal: based on your note and expected starter band of $22k/month, Finance has tentatively approved EWA at 1.5% for payment within 10 calendar days, conditional on ACH enrollment + signed EWA addendum. I’ve attached the proposed EWA spreadsheet for clarity.

Samantha — if you accept the PO number and the 1.5% EWA for 10-day payment, confirm and I’ll send the blanket PO + DocuSign EWA addendum. Once signed and ACH is set up we can move your term to Net 30 for ongoing invoices.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference

Attachments: EWA-Proposal-1.5pct.xlsx

Hi Priyom / Vivek / Marissa — thank you, this works for us. Confirming: 

- We accept the blanket PO workflow (please send PO-RED-2026-734 PDF).
- We accept the 1.5% early-pay at 10 days contingent on ACH enrollment and the EWA addendum.
- Our expected starting monthly invoice is ~$22k; we’ll enroll in the ACH form and sign the EWA doc as soon as you send it.

I’ll upload the requested onboarding contact ID to the DocuSign link and route the ACH details to finance@clearvault.io. Please send the PO and the EWA DocuSign.

Best,
